title: a Blueprint actor with components, variables and a working event graph
proves: author, compile, read back independently, converge on rerun, place in the level, and observe it run

steps.label: primitive puerts_blueprint_build is registered
1. build the beacon Blueprint from one spec
1. the Blueprint compiled clean
1. every connection in the spec resolved to real pins
1. the response names the generated class a level can spawn
primitive puerts_graph_inspect is registered
2. read the asset back with the independent inspector
2. both components are on the asset
2. all three member variables are on the asset
2. the graph has exactly the nodes the spec asked for
2. no node came back outside the builder vocabulary
2. inspecting did not dirty the package
2. the inspector reports a structure hash
3. rerunning the identical spec converges
3. re-read after the rerun
3. the structure hash is unmoved by an identical rebuild
3. a converged rerun wrote no new bytes to disk
steps.detail: a failure here is a real finding: blueprint_build re-saves an unchanged asset

steps.label: primitive puerts_scene_batch is registered

5. capture the viewport as the visual half of the feedback loop
6. observe the graph actually running
